Your team 4'feetus has completed web check-in. You’re ready to build!

As team leader, you receive the setup and credits instructions for your team. Credits are allocated once per team, not per member.

Join the neatHack Discord
Join our Discord for event announcements, help with setup and credits, and support from organisers and mentors.

https://neatlogs.com/discord

1. Build with neatlogs — free throughout the hackathon
All neatlogs paid plans are available to you for free for the duration of neatHack. We believe no good idea should be held back by a paywall.

Sign up at https://app.neatlogs.com and create your project.

Start with our step-by-step setup guide, with screenshots, a ready-to-use coding-agent prompt, and troubleshooting: https://neatlogs.com/hackathon/neatlogs-setup-guide.html

For framework-specific instructions, see https://docs.neatlogs.com.

Run your agent and verify that its traces appear in the dashboard. Use those traces to investigate failures and verify your fixes.

2. Set up Entire
Follow the Entire guide for neatHack: https://hack.entire.io/neathacks-2026/

Connect your GitHub repository, install the CLI, and capture your first checkpoint.

Explore Trails and optional Graph/Brain features. Include an accessible checkpoint link and ID in your submission.

3. Access cfo.ai paid plans for free
Use the dedicated neatHack signup link to access any cfo.ai paid plan for free: https://cfo.ai/neathacks

A card is required during signup. Immediately after signing up, cancel your subscription in Settings → Billing. You won’t be billed if you cancel immediately.

The neatHack team will provide your cfo.ai credits directly.

Use cfo.ai to plan your agent’s pricing, costs, revenue, and runway. Include the resulting business plan in your submission.

4. Claim your Crustdata credits
Get 5,000 Crustdata credits to build with company and people data.

Use promo code: NEATLOGS-OCT2026

Open https://app.crustdata.com and select “Have a promo code?” below Continue. Add the code before signing up with your email. Before you build
Every project must use neatlogs, Entire, and cfo.ai. Keep evidence of all three for your submission and demo.

Hackathon guide: https://neatlogs.com/hackathon

Build-log skill: https://neatlogs.com/hackathon/skill

View your team: https://neatlogs.com/hackathon/check-in

Get help on Discord: https://neatlogs.com/discord

See you at neatHack!

The neatlogs team

"""Scout eval harness.

Runs every task in evals/tasks.json through ``scout.agent.research`` and scores
the brief against the data source. Writes a JSON report that Pitstop reads.

    python -m evals.run --out results.json [--model claude-haiku] [--only stripe]
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import pathlib
import sys
import time
import uuid
from types import SimpleNamespace

import neatlogs

from evals.models import cost_usd, make_client
from scout.backends import get_backend

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DEFAULT_TOKEN_BUDGET = 8000
NUMBER_FIELDS = ("headcount", "total_funding_usd", "founded_year")


class MeteredClient:
    """Wraps a chat client and records each step without relying on agent code."""

    def __init__(self, inner, model: str) -> None:
        self.inner = inner
        self.model = model
        self.steps: list[dict] = []
        self._seen = 0
        self._names: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
        self.chat = SimpleNamespace(completions=SimpleNamespace(create=self._create))

    def _create(self, **kwargs):
        messages = kwargs.get("messages", [])
        tool_results = []
        for m in messages[self._seen:]:
            m = m if isinstance(m, dict) else m.model_dump()
            for c in m.get("tool_calls") or []:
                self._names[c["id"]] = (c["function"]["name"], c["function"]["arguments"])
            if m.get("role") == "tool":
                name, args = self._names.get(m.get("tool_call_id"), ("?", ""))
                content = str(m.get("content", ""))
                tool_results.append(
                    {"tool": name, "args": args, "chars": len(content), "error": content.startswith("ERROR"), "excerpt": content[:240]}
                )
        self._seen = len(messages)
        started = time.perf_counter()
        response = self.inner.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
        usage = getattr(response, "usage", None)
        message = response.choices[0].message
        self.steps.append(
            {
                "step": len(self.steps) + 1,
                "tool_results_in": tool_results,
                "prompt_tokens": getattr(usage, "prompt_tokens", 0) or 0,
                "completion_tokens": getattr(usage, "completion_tokens", 0) or 0,
                "latency_s": round(time.perf_counter() - started, 3),
                "tool_calls_out": [
                    {"tool": c.function.name, "args": c.function.arguments} for c in (message.tool_calls or [])
                ],
                "content_excerpt": (message.content or "")[:400],
            }
        )
        return response

    @property
    def prompt_tokens(self) -> int:
        return sum(s["prompt_tokens"] for s in self.steps)

    @property
    def completion_tokens(self) -> int:
        return sum(s["completion_tokens"] for s in self.steps)


def _as_int(value):
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return int(value)
    if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().replace(",", "").isdigit():
        return int(value.strip().replace(",", ""))
    return value


def truth_for(domain: str) -> dict:
    backend = get_backend()
    raw = backend.company(domain)
    people = backend.people(domain)

    def as_int(v):
        try:
            return int(v) if v not in (None, "") else None
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            return None

    return {
        "name": raw.get("company_name"),
        "headcount": as_int((raw.get("headcount") or {}).get("linkedin_headcount")),
        "total_funding_usd": as_int((raw.get("funding_and_investment") or {}).get("crunchbase_total_investment_usd")),
        "founded_year": as_int(raw.get("year_founded")),
        "people": {p.get("name") for p in people if p.get("name")},
    }


def score(task: dict, brief, error: str | None, metered: MeteredClient, budget: int) -> dict:
    checks, failures = {}, []
    checks["completed"] = isinstance(brief, dict)
    if not checks["completed"]:
        failures.append(f"no usable brief: {error}")
        brief = {}
    truth = truth_for(task["domain"])

    name = str(brief.get("company") or "")
    checks["identity"] = task["expect_name"].lower() in name.lower()
    if checks["completed"] and not checks["identity"]:
        failures.append(f"company name {name!r} does not match {task['expect_name']!r}")

    grounded = True
    for field in NUMBER_FIELDS:
        got, want = _as_int(brief.get(field)), truth[field]
        if not checks["completed"]:
            grounded = False
        elif want is None and got not in (None,):
            grounded = False
            failures.append(f"hallucinated {field}={got!r}: the data source has no value")
        elif want is not None and got != want:
            grounded = False
            failures.append(f"{field}={got!r} but the data source says {want!r}")
    checks["grounded_numbers"] = grounded

    people = brief.get("key_people") or []
    names = [p.get("name") for p in people if isinstance(p, dict)]
    unknown = [n for n in names if n not in truth["people"]]
    checks["grounded_people"] = bool(names) and not unknown
    if checks["completed"] and not names:
        failures.append("key_people is empty")
    if unknown:
        failures.append(f"key_people not in data source: {unknown}")

    total = metered.prompt_tokens + metered.completion_tokens
    checks["within_token_budget"] = total <= budget
    if not checks["within_token_budget"]:
        failures.append(f"used {total} tokens, budget is {budget}")

    return {"checks": checks, "failures": failures, "passed": all(checks.values())}


def _trace_id() -> str | None:
    try:
        from opentelemetry import trace

        ctx = trace.get_current_span().get_span_context()
        return format(ctx.trace_id, "032x") if ctx.trace_id else None
    except Exception:
        return None


@neatlogs.span(kind="WORKFLOW", name="scout.eval_task")
def run_task(task: dict, client, model: str, budget: int) -> dict:
    from scout.agent import research

    metered = MeteredClient(client, model)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    brief, error = None, None
    try:
        brief = research(task["input"], client=metered, model=model)
    except Exception as exc:
        error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    result = score(task, brief, error, metered, budget)
    neatlogs.log("scout task {task_id} passed={passed}", task_id=task["id"], passed=result["passed"])
    return {
        "id": task["id"],
        "input": task["input"],
        **result,
        "error": error,
        "brief": brief,
        "steps": metered.steps,
        "n_steps": len(metered.steps),
        "prompt_tokens": metered.prompt_tokens,
        "completion_tokens": metered.completion_tokens,
        "total_tokens": metered.prompt_tokens + metered.completion_tokens,
        "cost_usd": round(cost_usd(model, metered.prompt_tokens, metered.completion_tokens), 6),
        "latency_s": round(time.perf_counter() - started, 3),
        "tool_errors": sum(r["error"] for s in metered.steps for r in s["tool_results_in"]),
        "trace_id": _trace_id(),
    }


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=os.environ.get("SCOUT_MODEL", "claude-haiku"))
    ap.add_argument("--only", action="append")
    ap.add_argument("--budget", type=int, default=DEFAULT_TOKEN_BUDGET)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    run_id = os.environ.get("PITSTOP_RUN_ID", uuid.uuid4().hex[:8])
    variant = os.environ.get("PITSTOP_VARIANT", "manual")
    if os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY"):
        neatlogs.init(workflow_name="scout", tags=[f"run:{run_id}", f"variant:{variant}", f"model:{args.model}"])

    tasks = json.loads((ROOT / "evals" / "tasks.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if args.only:
        tasks = [t for t in tasks if t["id"] in args.only]
    client = make_client(args.model)
    results = []
    with neatlogs.identify(session_id=f"{run_id}-{variant}"):
        for task in tasks:
            results.append(run_task(task, client, args.model, args.budget))

    n = len(results) or 1
    summary = {
        "run_id": run_id,
        "variant": variant,
        "model": args.model,
        "data": get_backend().name,
        "tasks": len(results),
        "passed": sum(r["passed"] for r in results),
        "pass_rate": round(sum(r["passed"] for r in results) / n, 3),
        "total_tokens": sum(r["total_tokens"] for r in results),
        "cost_usd": round(sum(r["cost_usd"] for r in results), 6),
        "avg_latency_s": round(sum(r["latency_s"] for r in results) / n, 3),
        "avg_steps": round(sum(r["n_steps"] for r in results) / n, 2),
        "tool_errors": sum(r["tool_errors"] for r in results),
    }
    out = pathlib.Path(args.out)
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out.write_text(json.dumps({"summary": summary, "tasks": results}, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
    if os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY"):
        neatlogs.flush()
    print(json.dumps(summary))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

Find the root causes of the failures.

{"hypotheses": [{"id": "h1", "title": "...", "root_cause": "...",

Rules:

- `search` is copied verbatim from the current file, includes enough lines to be
  unique, and must match exactly once.
- Keep public function names and signatures unchanged.
- General fixes only: no hard-coded task ids, inputs, company names or answers.

{"edits": [{"file": "path", "search": "...", "replace": "..."}],
 "summary": "one-line commit message"}"""


def _attempts_text(attempts: list[dict]) -> str:

        f"- [{a['outcome']}] {a['title']}: {a['reason']}" for a in attempts
    )


@neatlogs.span(kind="AGENT", name="pitstop.diagnose", role="diagnostician", goal="root-cause agent failures from traces")
def diagnose(llm: LLM, target: Target, evidence: str, attempts: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    user = (
        f"Agent: {target.name} - {target.description}\n\n"
        f"Previous pit-stop attempts:\n{_attempts_text(attempts)}\n\n"
        f"Evidence:\n{evidence}\n\nSource:\n{target.source_bundle()}"
    )
    reply = llm.json("diagnose", DIAGNOSE_SYSTEM, user)
    hypotheses = reply.get("hypotheses", []) if isinstance(reply, dict) else reply
    hypotheses = sorted(hypotheses, key=lambda h: -float(h.get("confidence", 0)))
    neatlogs.log("diagnosed {n} hypotheses", n=len(hypotheses), titles=json.dumps([h.get("title") for h in hypotheses]))
    return hypotheses


@neatlogs.span(kind="AGENT", name="pitstop.patch", role="mechanic", goal="implement one fix as minimal edits")
def propose_patch(llm: LLM, target: Target, hypothesis: dict, feedback: str | None = None) -> tuple[list[Edit], str]:
    user = (
        f"Fix this root cause:\n{json.dumps(hypothesis, indent=2)}\n\n"
        f"Current source:\n{target.source_bundle(include_context=False)}"
    )
    if feedback:
        user += f"\n\nYour previous edit could not be applied or failed tests:\n{feedback}\nTry again."
    reply = llm.json("patch", PATCH_SYSTEM, user)
    edits = [Edit(e["file"], e["search"], e["replace"]) for e in reply.get("edits", [])]
    return edits, reply.get("summary") or hypothesis.get("title", "pitstop fix")

"""The pit-stop loop: evaluate, diagnose, patch, verify, keep or revert, repeat."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
import uuid
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Callable

import neatlogs

from pitstop import evidence as evidence_mod
from pitstop.crew import diagnose, propose_patch
from pitstop.llm import LLM, BudgetExceeded
from pitstop.target import EditError, Target


@dataclass
class Verdict:
    accept: bool
    reason: str
    deltas: dict


def _passing_checks(results: dict) -> int:
    return sum(sum(1 for ok in t["checks"].values() if ok) for t in results["tasks"])


def compare(before: dict, after: dict) -> Verdict:
    """Accept a candidate only if it measurably improves the agent and breaks nothing."""
    b, a = before["summary"], after["summary"]
    was_passing = {t["id"] for t in before["tasks"] if t["passed"]}
    regressions = [t["id"] for t in after["tasks"] if t["id"] in was_passing and not t["passed"]]
    deltas = {
        "passed": (b["passed"], a["passed"]),
        "checks": (_passing_checks(before), _passing_checks(after)),
        "total_tokens": (b["total_tokens"], a["total_tokens"]),
        "cost_usd": (b["cost_usd"], a["cost_usd"]),
        "tool_errors": (b["tool_errors"], a["tool_errors"]),
        "avg_steps": (b["avg_steps"], a["avg_steps"]),
    }
    if regressions:
        return Verdict(False, f"regressed previously passing tasks: {regressions}", deltas)
    if a["passed"] > b["passed"]:
        return Verdict(True, f"{a['passed'] - b['passed']} more task(s) pass", deltas)
    token_cut = 1 - a["total_tokens"] / max(b["total_tokens"], 1)
    checks_b, checks_a = deltas["checks"]
    if checks_a > checks_b and token_cut > -0.2:
        return Verdict(True, f"{checks_a - checks_b} more check(s) pass", deltas)
    if checks_a == checks_b and token_cut >= 0.10:
        return Verdict(True, f"same results with {token_cut:.0%} fewer tokens", deltas)
    return Verdict(False, "no measurable improvement", deltas)


def _done(results: dict) -> bool:
    return results["summary"]["passed"] == results["summary"]["tasks"]


@dataclass
class HealRun:
    run_id: str
    target: str
    branch: str | None = None
    baseline: dict | None = None
    final: dict | None = None
    attempts: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    evals: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    stopped: str = ""
    started: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    finished: float | None = None


Emit = Callable[..., None]


def _noop(event: str, **data) -> None:
    pass


@neatlogs.span(kind="TOOL", name="pitstop.evaluate", tool_name="run_evals")
def _evaluate(target: Target, run: HealRun, variant: str, emit: Emit) -> dict:
    emit("eval_start", variant=variant)
    results = target.evaluate(run.run_id, variant)
    run.evals.append({"variant": variant, "summary": results["summary"], "path": results.get("path"),
                      "trace_ids": [t.get("trace_id") for t in results["tasks"]]})
    emit("eval_done", variant=variant, results=results)
    return results


@neatlogs.span(kind="WORKFLOW", name="pitstop.heal")
def heal(
    target: Target,
    llm: LLM,
    *,
    max_rounds: int = 4,
    tries_per_round: int = 2,
    traces: evidence_mod.NeatlogsTraces | None = None,
    emit: Emit = _noop,
    run_id: str | None = None,
) -> HealRun:
    run = HealRun(run_id=run_id or time.strftime("%m%d-%H%M") + "-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:4], target=target.name)
    target.ensure_clean()
    run.branch = target.start_branch(run.run_id)
    emit("start", run=run)

    current = _evaluate(target, run, "baseline", emit)
    run.baseline = current
    try:
        for round_no in range(1, max_rounds + 1):
            if _done(current):
                run.stopped = "all tasks pass"
                break
            emit("diagnose_start", round=round_no)
            evidence = evidence_mod.build(current, traces)
            hypotheses = diagnose(llm, target, evidence, run.attempts)
            emit("diagnosed", round=round_no, hypotheses=hypotheses)
            improved = False
            for hypothesis in hypotheses[:tries_per_round]:
                attempt = _try(target, llm, run, current, hypothesis, round_no, emit)
                run.attempts.append(attempt)
                if attempt["outcome"] == "accepted":
                    current = attempt["_results"]
                    improved = True
                    break
            if not improved:
                emit("stuck", round=round_no)
        else:
            run.stopped = run.stopped or f"reached {max_rounds} rounds"
        if not run.stopped:
            run.stopped = "all tasks pass" if _done(current) else f"reached {max_rounds} rounds"
    except BudgetExceeded as exc:
        run.stopped = f"budget: {exc}"
        target.revert()
    run.final = current
    run.finished = time.time()
    for a in run.attempts:
        a.pop("_results", None)
    emit("finish", run=run)
    return run


def _try(target: Target, llm: LLM, run: HealRun, current: dict, hypothesis: dict, round_no: int, emit: Emit) -> dict:
    title = hypothesis.get("title", "untitled fix")
    attempt = {"round": round_no, "title": title, "hypothesis": hypothesis, "outcome": "rejected", "reason": "", "diff": ""}
    emit("attempt_start", attempt=attempt)
    feedback = None
    for repair in range(2):
        edits, summary = propose_patch(llm, target, hypothesis, feedback)
        attempt["summary"] = summary
        try:
            files = target.apply(edits)
        except EditError as exc:
            feedback = str(exc)
            emit("patch_failed", attempt=attempt, error=feedback, will_retry=repair == 0)
            neatlogs.log("patch could not be applied: {error}", level="warning", error=feedback)
            continue
        ok, output = target.run_tests()
        if ok:
            break
        target.revert()
        feedback = f"tests failed after your edit:\n{output[-1500:]}"
        emit("tests_failed", attempt=attempt, output=output, will_retry=repair == 0)
        neatlogs.log("tests failed after patch", level="warning")
    else:
        attempt["reason"] = f"could not produce a working patch: {feedback[:300]}"
        emit("attempt_done", attempt=attempt)
        return attempt

    attempt["files"] = files
    attempt["diff"] = target.diff()
    emit("patched", attempt=attempt)
    candidate = _evaluate(target, run, f"r{round_no}-{len(run.attempts) + 1}", emit)
    verdict = compare(current, candidate)
    attempt["deltas"] = verdict.deltas
    attempt["reason"] = verdict.reason
    attempt["variant"] = candidate["summary"]["variant"]
    if verdict.accept:
        attempt["outcome"] = "accepted"
        attempt["_results"] = candidate
        b, a = current["summary"], candidate["summary"]
        attempt["commit"] = target.commit(
            f"pitstop: {attempt['summary']}\n\n{hypothesis.get('root_cause', '')}\n\n"
            f"verdict: {verdict.reason}\n"
            f"passed {b['passed']}/{b['tasks']} -> {a['passed']}/{a['tasks']}, "
            f"tokens {b['total_tokens']} -> {a['total_tokens']}, tool errors {b['tool_errors']} -> {a['tool_errors']}\n"
            f"pitstop-run: {run.run_id}"
        )
    else:
        target.revert()
    neatlogs.log("attempt {title}: {outcome} ({reason})", title=title, outcome=attempt["outcome"], reason=verdict.reason)
    emit("attempt_done", attempt=attempt)
    return attempt

"""Write the pit-stop report: before/after numbers, every attempt, trace ids."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import pathlib

from pitstop.heal import HealRun
from pitstop.llm import Ledger


def _pct(before: float, after: float) -> str:
    if not before:
        return ""
    change = (after - before) / before
    return f" ({change:+.0%})"


def markdown(run: HealRun, ledger: Ledger, traces_used: int = 0) -> str:
    b, f = run.baseline["summary"], run.final["summary"]
    accepted = [a for a in run.attempts if a["outcome"] == "accepted"]
    rejected = [a for a in run.attempts if a["outcome"] != "accepted"]
    lines = [
        f"# Pit stop `{run.run_id}` on `{run.target}`",
        "",
        f"- Branch: `{run.branch}`",
        f"- Model under test: `{b['model']}` · data: `{b['data']}`",
        f"- Stopped because: {run.stopped}",
        f"- Pitstop's own spend: ${ledger.spent_usd:.4f} over {ledger.calls} model calls ({ledger.tokens} tokens)",
        f"- neatlogs trace reads: {traces_used}",
        "",
        "## Before → after",
        "",
        "| metric | before | after |",
        "|---|---|---|",
        f"| tasks passing | {b['passed']}/{b['tasks']} | {f['passed']}/{f['tasks']} |",
        f"| total tokens | {b['total_tokens']} | {f['total_tokens']}{_pct(b['total_tokens'], f['total_tokens'])} |",
        f"| est. cost (USD) | {b['cost_usd']:.4f} | {f['cost_usd']:.4f}{_pct(b['cost_usd'], f['cost_usd'])} |",
        f"| tool errors | {b['tool_errors']} | {f['tool_errors']} |",
        f"| avg steps | {b['avg_steps']} | {f['avg_steps']} |",
        f"| avg latency (s) | {b['avg_latency_s']} | {f['avg_latency_s']} |",
        "",
        f"## Accepted fixes ({len(accepted)})",
    ]
    for a in accepted:
        d = a["deltas"]
        lines += [
            "",
            f"### {a['summary']}",
            f"Round {a['round']} · commit `{a['commit'][:10]}` · {a['reason']}",
            "",
            f"**Root cause.** {a['hypothesis'].get('root_cause', '')}",
            "",
            "**Evidence.** " + "; ".join(a["hypothesis"].get("evidence", [])),
            "",
            f"passed {d['passed'][0]} → {d['passed'][1]}, checks {d['checks'][0]} → {d['checks'][1]}, "
            f"tokens {d['total_tokens'][0]} → {d['total_tokens'][1]}, tool errors {d['tool_errors'][0]} → {d['tool_errors'][1]}",
            "",
            "```diff",
            a["diff"].strip(),
            "```",
        ]
    lines += ["", f"## Rejected attempts ({len(rejected)})", ""]
    if not rejected:
        lines.append("None.")
    for a in rejected:
        lines.append(f"- Round {a['round']}: **{a['title']}**: {a['reason']}")
    lines += ["", "## Eval runs and neatlogs traces", ""]
    for e in run.evals:
        s = e["summary"]
        ids = ", ".join(f"`{t}`" for t in e["trace_ids"] if t) or "(neatlogs export off)"
        lines.append(f"- `{e['variant']}`: {s['passed']}/{s['tasks']} pass, {s['total_tokens']} tokens. Traces: {ids}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def write(run: HealRun, ledger: Ledger, out_dir: pathlib.Path, traces_used: int = 0) -> pathlib.Path:
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    md = out_dir / f"pitstop-{run.run_id}.md"
    md.write_text(markdown(run, ledger, traces_used), encoding="utf-8")
    payload = {
        "run_id": run.run_id, "target": run.target, "branch": run.branch, "stopped": run.stopped,
        "baseline": run.baseline["summary"], "final": run.final["summary"], "evals": run.evals,
        "attempts": run.attempts, "ledger": {"spent_usd": ledger.spent_usd, "calls": ledger.calls, "tokens": ledger.tokens},
        "started": run.started, "finished": run.finished,
    }
    (out_dir / f"pitstop-{run.run_id}.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
    return md

"""pitstop: an autonomous pit crew for AI agents.

    pitstop init-demo                 # copy the Scout patient into sandbox/scout as a git repo
    pitstop eval  --target sandbox/scout
    pitstop heal  --target sandbox/scout --rounds 4 --budget 1.50
    pitstop doctor
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.table import Table

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
console = Console(highlight=False)


def _load_env() -> None:
    try:
        from dotenv import load_dotenv

        load_dotenv(ROOT / ".env")
        load_dotenv()
    except ImportError:
        pass


def _init_neatlogs(run_tag: str | None = None) -> bool:
    if not os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY"):
        return False
    import neatlogs

    tags = ["pitstop"] + ([f"run:{run_tag}"] if run_tag else [])
    neatlogs.init(workflow_name="pitstop", tags=tags)
    return True


def _summary_table(title: str, results: dict) -> Table:
    table = Table(title=title, title_justify="left")
    for col in ("task", "pass", "tokens", "steps", "tool err", "failures"):
        table.add_column(col)
    for t in results["tasks"]:
        table.add_row(
            t["id"], "[green]yes[/]" if t["passed"] else "[red]no[/]", str(t["total_tokens"]), str(t["n_steps"]),
            str(t["tool_errors"]), "; ".join(t["failures"])[:110],
        )
    s = results["summary"]
    table.caption = (
        f"{s['passed']}/{s['tasks']} pass · {s['total_tokens']} tokens · ${s['cost_usd']:.4f} · "
        f"{s['tool_errors']} tool errors · model {s['model']} · data {s['data']}"
    )
    return table


class Narrator:
    """Prints the pit stop as it happens."""

    def __call__(self, event: str, **d) -> None:
        handler = getattr(self, f"on_{event}", None)
        if handler:
            handler(**d)

    def on_start(self, run):
        console.print(Panel(f"Pit stop [bold]{run.run_id}[/] on [bold]{run.target}[/] · branch {run.branch}", style="cyan"))

    def on_eval_start(self, variant):
        console.print(f"[dim]running evals ({variant})...[/]")

    def on_eval_done(self, variant, results):
        console.print(_summary_table(f"evals: {variant}", results))

    def on_diagnose_start(self, round):
        console.rule(f"round {round}: reading traces and diagnosing")

    def on_diagnosed(self, round, hypotheses):
        for h in hypotheses:
            console.print(f"  [yellow]{h.get('id')}[/] {h.get('title')} [dim](confidence {h.get('confidence')})[/]")
            console.print(f"     [dim]{h.get('root_cause', '')[:220]}[/]")

    def on_attempt_start(self, attempt):
        console.print(f"[bold]trying:[/] {attempt['title']}")

    def on_patch_failed(self, attempt, error, will_retry):
        console.print(f"  [red]patch did not apply[/]: {error.splitlines()[0][:160]}" + (" → retrying" if will_retry else ""))

    def on_tests_failed(self, attempt, output, will_retry):
        console.print("  [red]tests failed after patch[/]" + (" → retrying" if will_retry else ""))

    def on_patched(self, attempt):
        console.print(f"  patched {', '.join(attempt['files'])}")
        console.print(f"[dim]{attempt['diff'][:1500]}[/]")

    def on_attempt_done(self, attempt):
        color = "green" if attempt["outcome"] == "accepted" else "red"
        console.print(f"  [{color}]{attempt['outcome'].upper()}[/]: {attempt['reason']}")

    def on_stuck(self, round):
        console.print("  [yellow]no hypothesis improved the agent this round[/]")

    def on_finish(self, run):
        b, f = run.baseline["summary"], run.final["summary"]
        console.print(Panel(
            f"{run.stopped}\npassing {b['passed']}/{b['tasks']} → {f['passed']}/{f['tasks']} · "
            f"tokens {b['total_tokens']} → {f['total_tokens']} · tool errors {b['tool_errors']} → {f['tool_errors']}",
            title="pit stop finished", style="green" if f["passed"] > b["passed"] else "yellow",
        ))


def cmd_init_demo(args) -> int:
    src = ROOT / "patients" / "scout"
    dest = pathlib.Path(args.dest).resolve()
    if dest.exists():
        if not args.force:
            console.print(f"[red]{dest} exists[/] (use --force to replace)")
            return 1
        shutil.rmtree(dest, onerror=lambda f, p, e: (os.chmod(p, 0o700), f(p)))
    shutil.copytree(src, dest, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", ".pitstop", ".pytest_cache"))
    (dest / ".gitignore").write_text(".pitstop/\n__pycache__/\n.pytest_cache/\n", encoding="utf-8")
    for cmd in (["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main"], ["git", "add", "-A"],
                ["git", "-c", "user.name=Scout", "-c", "user.email=scout@example.invalid", "commit", "-q", "-m", "Scout v0"]):
        subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=dest, check=True)
    console.print(f"Scout patient ready at [bold]{dest}[/]")
    return 0


def cmd_eval(args) -> int:
    from pitstop.target import Target

    _load_env()
    target = Target(args.target, model=args.model)
    results = target.evaluate(args.run_id or "manual", args.variant)
    console.print(_summary_table(f"evals: {args.variant}", results))
    return 0


def cmd_heal(args) -> int:
    from pitstop.evidence import NeatlogsTraces
    from pitstop.heal import heal
    from pitstop.llm import LLM, Ledger
    from pitstop.report import write
    from pitstop.target import Target

    _load_env()
    traced = _init_neatlogs()
    if not os.environ.get("LITELLM_API_KEY"):
        console.print("[red]LITELLM_API_KEY is not set[/] (see .env.example)")
        return 2
    target = Target(args.target, model=args.model)
    ledger = Ledger(budget_usd=args.budget)
    llm = LLM(args.pitstop_model, ledger)
    traces = NeatlogsTraces()
    console.print(
        f"neatlogs export: {'on' if traced else 'off'} · trace read-back: {'on' if traces.enabled else 'off (local telemetry)'} · "
        f"budget ${args.budget:.2f}"
    )
    run = heal(target, llm, max_rounds=args.rounds, tries_per_round=args.tries, traces=traces if traces.enabled else None, emit=Narrator())
    report = write(run, ledger, pathlib.Path(args.reports), traces.reads)
    console.print(f"report: {report}")
    if traced:
        import neatlogs

        neatlogs.flush()
    if traces.failures:
        console.print(f"[yellow]{len(traces.failures)} neatlogs trace reads failed[/]; first: {traces.failures[0]}")
    return 0


def cmd_doctor(args) -> int:
    _load_env()
    rows = []

    def check(name, ok, detail=""):
        rows.append((name, "[green]ok[/]" if ok else "[red]missing[/]", detail))

    check("LITELLM_API_KEY", bool(os.environ.get("LITELLM_API_KEY")), "hackathon model key (team leader's check-in email)")
    check("NEATLOGS_API_KEY", bool(os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")), "neatlogs project key: Settings → API keys")
    check("neatlogs CLI", bool(shutil.which("neatlogs")), "npm i -g neatlogs-cli (trace read-back)")
    check("NEATLOGS_CLI_PROJECT", bool(os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_CLI_PROJECT")), "project id for `neatlogs traces`")
    check("entire CLI", bool(shutil.which("entire")), "irm https://entire.io/install.ps1 | iex")
    check("CRUSTDATA_API_KEY", bool(os.environ.get("CRUSTDATA_API_KEY")), "optional: SCOUT_DATA=live")
    table = Table(title="pitstop doctor")
    for col in ("check", "status", "notes"):
        table.add_column(col)
    for r in rows:
        table.add_row(*r)
    console.print(table)
    if os.environ.get("LITELLM_API_KEY") and args.ping:
        from pitstop.llm import LLM, Ledger

        reply = LLM(args.pitstop_model, Ledger(0.05)).json("ping", "Reply with JSON.", 'Reply {"ok": true}')
        console.print(f"LiteLLM ping ({args.pitstop_model}): {json.dumps(reply)}")
    return 0


def main(argv=None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="pitstop", description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p = sub.add_parser("init-demo", help="copy the Scout patient into a fresh git repo")
    p.add_argument("--dest", default=str(ROOT / "sandbox" / "scout"))
    p.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    p.set_defaults(fn=cmd_init_demo)

    for name, fn in (("eval", cmd_eval), ("heal", cmd_heal)):
        p = sub.add_parser(name)
        p.add_argument("--target", default=str(ROOT / "sandbox" / "scout"))
        p.add_argument("--model", default=os.environ.get("SCOUT_MODEL", "claude-haiku"), help="model under test")
        p.set_defaults(fn=fn)
        if name == "eval":
            p.add_argument("--variant", default="manual")
            p.add_argument("--run-id")
        else:
            p.add_argument("--pitstop-model", default=os.environ.get("PITSTOP_MODEL", "claude-sonnet-4.6"))
            p.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=4)
            p.add_argument("--tries", type=int, default=2, help="hypotheses to try per round")
            p.add_argument("--budget", type=float, default=1.50, help="USD cap for Pitstop's own model calls")
            p.add_argument("--reports", default=str(ROOT / "reports"))

    p = sub.add_parser("doctor")
    p.add_argument("--ping", action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--pitstop-model", default=os.environ.get("PITSTOP_MODEL", "claude-sonnet-4.6"))
    p.set_defaults(fn=cmd_doctor)

    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if sys.stdout.encoding and sys.stdout.encoding.lower() != "utf-8":
        sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    return args.fn(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# Pitstop

**An autonomous pit crew for AI agents.** Point Pitstop at an agent repo. It runs
the agent's evals, reads the neatlogs traces of the failing runs, works out the
root cause, patches the code, re-runs the evals, and keeps the patch only if the
numbers improve. Each accepted fix lands as its own git commit with before/after
metrics and trace ids. Patches that don't help are reverted.

Built for [neatHack](https://neatlogs.com/hackathon) (Oct 10–12, 2026) by team **4'feetus**.

```
pitstop heal --target sandbox/scout

 round 1       diagnose → "final answer is fenced JSON, json.loads fails"      ACCEPTED (+17 checks)
 round 2       diagnose → "URLs passed to company_lookup unnormalised"         ACCEPTED (+3 checks)
 round 3       diagnose → "people_search dumps full profiles into context"     ACCEPTED (3 → 5 tasks)
 round 4       diagnose → "prompt forces the model to invent missing numbers"  ACCEPTED (5 → 6 tasks)
 final         6/6 tasks pass · fewer tokens · 0 tool errors

*(Offline run with scripted models, from `tests/test_heal_offline.py`. Real runs use the hackathon LiteLLM models and are linked in [`reports/`](reports/).)*

## How it works

```
            ┌──────────── evals (pitstop.toml: eval_cmd) ─────────────┐
            ▼                                                          │
  target agent ──traces──▶ neatlogs ──CLI read-back──▶ evidence ──▶ DIAGNOSE (claude-sonnet-4.6)
                                                                       │ ranked root-cause hypotheses
                                                                       ▼
            keep + commit ◀── ACCEPT ◀── compare ◀── evals ◀── tests ◀── PATCH (search/replace edits)
            revert        ◀── REJECT ◀──┘                     │
                                     repair once ◀── edit didn't apply / tests failed
```

1. **Evaluate.** Run the target's eval command (declared in its `pitstop.toml`).
   The harness meters every model call itself, so the agent can't hide steps.
2. **Collect evidence.** For each failing task: failed checks, a step-by-step
   timeline (tool calls, arguments, result sizes, errors, tokens per step) and
   the neatlogs spans for that task's trace, read back with the `neatlogs` CLI.
3. **Diagnose.** The model returns ranked hypotheses, each citing evidence
   (task, step, failure text), and sees every earlier attempt and why it was rejected.
4. **Patch.** Minimal search/replace edits, limited to files the target marks
   `editable`. Evals and data are read-only, so the agent can't game its own tests.
   If an edit doesn't apply or the unit tests fail, the error goes back to the
   model for one repair attempt.
5. **Verify.** Re-run the evals. Accept only if more tasks pass, or more checks
   pass, or results stay equal with ≥10% fewer tokens, and no passing task
   regresses. Otherwise revert.
6. **Report.** A markdown + JSON report with the before/after table, every
   accepted diff, every rejected attempt and why, and all trace ids.

Pitstop has a hard USD budget (`--budget`) for its own model calls and stops
cleanly (reverting any half-applied patch) when it hits it.

## The patient: Scout

[`patients/scout`](patients/scout) is a small but real tool-using research agent:
company website in, JSON brief out (headcount, funding, founding year, HQ,
leaders), built on Crustdata company and people data. Its eval checks that the
brief parses, names the right company, matches the data source number for
number (no invented values), lists real people, and stays within a token budget.

Scout ships with the faults real agents ship with. Pitstop isn't told what they are.

### Using it on your own agent

Add a `pitstop.toml` to your agent repo:

```toml
[target]
name = "my-agent"
description = "what it does"
eval_cmd = ["{python}", "-m", "evals.run", "--out", "{out}", "--model", "{model}"]
test_cmd = ["{python}", "-m", "pytest", "-q"]
editable = ["agent/*.py", "agent/prompts.py"]
context  = ["evals/run.py"]
```

Your eval command must write JSON with a `summary` (`tasks`, `passed`,
`total_tokens`, `cost_usd`, `tool_errors`, ...) and per-task `checks`,
`failures`, `steps` and `trace_id`. See [`patients/scout/evals/run.py`](patients/scout/evals/run.py).

| Tool | How Pitstop uses it |

| **neatlogs** | Every Scout run and every Pitstop step is traced (`neatlogs.wrap`, `@neatlogs.span`, `neatlogs.log`). Pitstop reads failing traces back with the `neatlogs` CLI as diagnosis evidence. Before/after trace ids go in each commit and report. |

| **LiteLLM (hackathon proxy)** | All model calls: `claude-haiku` for Scout, `claude-sonnet-4.6` for Pitstop. |

reports/          reports from real runs

## The project: Pitstop
Pitstop is an agent that fixes other AI agents. It:
1. Runs an agent's tests and reads the neatlogs traces of the runs that failed.
2. Works out the root cause and patches the code.
